scope: Simplify video-call preparation, explicitly triggered email invitations and exact invitation return after login

checks.typecheck: passed all workspaces on final source
checks.format: passed changed supported source and documentation files

checks: 390px guest invitation link requires login and exposes no private recipient or room
1440px guest invitation link requires login and exposes no private recipient or room
A guest signs in from an email link and returns to the exact requested invitation even with two active meetings
Studio prepares a private random room link and saves UUID-scoped invitation without automatic email
A deliberate double click dispatches one invitation containing only its ID and reports provider acceptance
Accepted email status survives a reload and offers no duplicate send
Copy forwards the protected invitation URL; clipboard denial exposes selectable text
Revocation requires explicit confirmation before removing the private invitation
A network failure preserves the saved call and requires status verification instead of claiming email success
Missing email configuration leaves the invitation usable and copyable without false delivery confirmation
A patient email link isolates the requested invitation and exposes no staff or email controls
Entering a call reauthorizes the exact invitation before same-tab navigation to the mocked provider
An unavailable targeted invitation never substitutes another available meeting
The staff workflow fits desktop without horizontal overflow

legacy_v9_broad_smoke.reason: Pre-existing project-heading expectation MetiMaia is stale against current Crescere insieme. heading; dedicated current video browser suite passed.

limits: No real email or real Hostpoint meeting created. Database and provider tests are local/mocked.
Provider acceptance does not establish delivery or reading.
Saved access lasts seven days; appointment date/time are agreed separately.
Random URL preparation does not provision a meeting or establish external Hostpoint service availability.
Exact invitation access still requires recipient sign-in and current server authorization.
Live domain and production Supabase configuration require manual deployment and a real two-account test.
The previously reported Android Play Protect block is not changed or verified by this release.
